latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Japanese AI Video skill.
- Convert video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB into Japanese-localized videos with subtitles or dubbed audio.
- Fast processing (1–2 minutes) on cloud GPUs; outputs 1080p MP4 files.
- Supports uploading, editing (e.g., add BGM or text), previewing, and exporting.
- Anonymous access with easy session setup and 100 free credits for new users.
- Guided workflows with error handling and direct mapping of user prompts to video actions.
